title: Battle of Carabobo (1814)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Carabobo (1814)", at revision 1370436287, opens: "The First Battle of Carabobo (1814) was a battle in the Venezuelan War of Independence, in which the forces of the Second Republic, commanded by Simón Bolívar, defeated the Spanish forces under Field marshal Juan Manuel de Cajigal y Martínez." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5722281, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1814 battle in the Venezuelan War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
